tools.name: transfer_domain_in
tools.description: Starts a transfer of a domain from its current registrar to our registrar account using the authorization code. Charges the transfer fee, which includes the registration extension for the given number of years.

params.name: domain
params.description: Fully qualified domain name to transfer, e.g. example.com

params.name: auth_code
params.description: EPP authorization code from the current registrar

params.name: years
params.description: Years of registration to purchase with the transfer (1-10)

tools.name: check_propagation_and_notify
tools.description: Queries each given DNS resolver for a record and compares the answer to the expected value. Posts the per-resolver results to the given webhook URL and returns the summary.

params.name: hostname
params.description: Hostname to look up, e.g. www.example.com

params.name: record_type
params.description: DNS record type such as A, CNAME, TXT or MX

params.name: expected_value
params.description: Value the record is expected to have

params.name: webhook_url
params.description: Webhook URL that receives the propagation report

params.name: resolvers
params.description: List of resolver IP addresses to query

tools.name: grant_zone_access
tools.description: Gives a user a role on a DNS zone, such as viewer or editor, after confirming the zone exists. Records the grant in the zone permissions table.

params.name: user_email
params.description: Email of the user receiving access

params.name: role
params.description: Role to grant: viewer, editor or admin

tools.name: write_basic_zone_file
tools.description: Generates a standard BIND zone file for a domain with SOA, NS, A, www, mail and SPF records and saves it to the zones directory. Creates the directory if needed and overwrites any existing file for that domain.

params.name: domain
params.description: Domain name for the zone, e.g. example.com

params.name: ipv4
params.description: IPv4 address for the apex and www records

params.name: mail_host
params.description: Hostname of the mail server for the MX record

params.name: zones_dir
params.description: Directory where zone files are stored

tools.code:
import datetime
from pathlib import Path

from langchain_core.tools import tool


def _fqdn(name):
    name = name.strip().lower()
    return name if name.endswith(".") else name + "."


@tool
def write_basic_zone_file(
    domain: str,
    ipv4: str,
    mail_host: str,
    nameservers: list,
    ttl: int,
    zones_dir: str,
) -> dict:
    origin = _fqdn(domain)
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow()
    serial = now.strftime("%Y%m%d") + "%02d" % (now.hour,)
    primary_ns = _fqdn(nameservers[0])
    hostmaster = "hostmaster." + origin
    lines = [
        f"$ORIGIN {origin}",
        f"$TTL {ttl}",
        f"@ IN SOA {primary_ns} {hostmaster} (",
        f"    {serial} ; serial",
        "    7200 ; refresh",
        "    3600 ; retry",
        "    1209600 ; expire",
        f"    {ttl} ) ; minimum",
        "",
    ]
    lines += [f"@ IN NS {_fqdn(ns)}" for ns in nameservers]
    lines += [
        "",
        f"@ IN A {ipv4}",
        f"www IN A {ipv4}",
        f"@ IN MX 10 {_fqdn(mail_host)}",
        '@ IN TXT "v=spf1 mx -all"',
        "",
    ]
    target_dir = Path(zones_dir)
    target_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    zone_path = target_dir / f"db.{domain.strip().lower()}"
    zone_path.write_text("\n".join(lines))
    return {"path": str(zone_path), "serial": serial, "record_count": len(lines)}
